name: Count Dracula
note: Polygons in the rest pose (A1) pixels. Gothic sheets (the Horseman's style), the owner's look. Transylvania's champion: any chair, drawn facing right and mirrored as the seat needs. The master is the rest pose's OWN head. Every pose but rest a whole-figure frame with its own drawn head. His dark iron chalice stands on the felt by his right hand: part of that forearm's piece at rest and a props box in every frame but `sip` (C2) and `swirl` (C5), where he holds it.

what.A1: Rest: forearms on the table's edge, hands apart, the chalice by his right hand, a thin closed smile
what.A3: Check: one long black nail taps the felt
what.A4: Call: right hand pushes forward along the felt
what.A5: Bet: leans in, right hand pushed well forward
what.A6: Fold: a bored flick of the fingers
what.B1: All in: both hands push forward together
what.B2: Show: right hand turns palm up
what.B3: Big win: both hands raised and spread, the cape opening like wings, fangs bared (`win_big`)
what.B5: Smiles without showing his teeth (decoy for B4)
what.C1: Runs a fingernail along the table (decoy for B6)
what.C2: Sips from his chalice (a tell AND an idle: the same drawing)
what.C3: Watches the pulse in someone's throat
what.C5: Swirls the wine in his chalice (a fidget)
what.C6: Arriving: sweeps his cape back as he takes the chair (`arrive`)
what.D1: Talking: one long hand raised, palm open
what.D2: Facing a big bet: sits back, looking down his nose
what.D3: Lost a pot: a thin, cold smile, eyes narrowed
what.D4: Crushing loss: a snarl, fangs bared, nails gouging the felt (`lose_big`)
what.D5: Heads up: leaning in on both forearms
what.D6: A low laugh, head tipped back, fangs showing

rest.what: his right forearm, cuff and hand, and the chalice by it
his left forearm, cuff and hand
